description.value: Your face—if you have one—emotes differently than most creatures, making it hard for others to read your intentions and emotions. You become trained in Deception. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to [[/act create-a-diversion]] and Lie. If you would automatically become trained in Deception (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.
